findings: Ctrl+F5 invokes SearchCommand; directory-list Space toggles inclusion and Delete removes roots through previously reviewed busy-guarded commands. Drag/drop remains separate unguarded input.
SameContents checkbox is enabled only when not busy and SameSize is checked, confirming intended UI coupling. Filename-pattern editor likewise requires SameFileName and not busy.

Directory template reads FolderIcon in visibility bindings and image source separately. Since the getter can invoke native icon lookup, repeated binding evaluation can call the service multiple times; Windows service cache mitigates it, Linux returns null. No performance measurement claimed.
Design.DataContext instantiates the full MainViewModel, whose reviewed constructor reads preferences and may start update checking. Actual designer construction/external activity was not run.
Theme, close and update commands are exposed in title menus. No menu invoked and no system setting changed.
